exposure: Original question/query, Korean author item, original design/validation, prior gold metadata and C findings were read. Own SQL and five raw DOCX source/formatting reopens are independent actual executions. This is not a blind or human expert review.

requested answer roles and fields.independent_derivation: The English lists agreements and the original Korean asks for 합의 목록. Both identify a collection of Agreement entities. The parenthetical names those entities as HARQ decisions; it does not ask what each decision says. A stable resolutionId is therefore sufficient to identify every listed entity. This conclusion uses the unchanged question and Korean item, not the former gold column count.
requested answer roles and fields.query_evidence: MATCH (a:Agreement), unchanged three RETURN columns; required_fields contains nonnullable string resolutionId sourced from a.resolutionId.
requested answer roles and fields.assessment: PASS for identity-list semantics. The original query returns meeting and content as useful context, but the fixed criteria explicitly rejects promoting every unrequested projection to a mandatory field. The design §8 instructs contentWithEquations for generation/rendering and supports full decision context when such content is requested; it does not expressly require verbatim decision-body/equation reproduction for this List question. Content-bearing responses may be richer; this contract certifies the identity list, not all rendered decision content.
requested answer roles and fields.original_quote: List the agreements on HARQ feedback (HARQ decisions).

population and source context.independent_derivation: The own phase-2 design fixes RAN1 Final Report body Resolution/Agreement records and excludes Annex and future semantic vector search. My immutable SQLite join and five original DOCX reopens independently checked all sixteen original possible prefix rows. C separately reextracted the latest ten reports (3176 windows, 52981 blocks and 112 unbound candidates) and the cutoff115/116/116b raw registry plus extra-marker frontier; those reviewed receipts are supporting completeness evidence, not my independent execution of their entire source census.
population and source context.query_evidence: Same frozen Agreement nodes, MADE_AT edges and Meeting nodes; the repair only reads existing scalar a.content. No source-enriched node/property is introduced.
population and source context.assessment: PASS within the captured WG/phase Final-Report body and finite selection frontier. The count21058 is loaded Agreement identities, and21288 is the join population; neither is a certification of21058 physical source boundaries. The whole repaired421 pool was independently recomputed, while physical own-role certification is restricted to the possible cutoff frontier.

filters and relationship meaning.independent_derivation: The specific authored query uses case-sensitive HARQ AND feedback in content, and the own implementation validation describes keyword-based trends. This positive author context supports literal recorded-search eligibility rather than a new semantic topic classifier. The raw122b8.7.2-011 own LS endorses OCC/NTN; its HARQ/feedback words occur only after later three-column TDoc catalogue headers, in R1-2507312. The proposed prefix condition removes that proven ownership contamination. My source/styles and active-run followup finds both words outside deleted/strike/hidden text in every one of the fifteen kept prefix records.
filters and relationship meaning.query_evidence: Unchanged literal prefilter; first standalone R1-number TAB title TAB source header; HARQ and feedback must both occur in lines before that header.
filters and relationship meaning.assessment: PASS for this bounded literal-search repair. AGR-123-11.6-001 contains the two terms in different use-case table rows; it remains eligible under the original conjunction, without asserting a newly adopted HARQ mechanism. A generic own Final-CR title can be wrongly cut, as the synthetic control openly demonstrates. That limitation is not a global-parser pass: the actual16 cutoff candidates were reopened, no legitimate title-only match is removed there, and the repair can only remove lower rows, never promote them above115.
evidence_locators: own source role packet record AGR-122b-8.7.2-011

counting unit and join multiplicity.independent_derivation: One listed object is an Agreement resolutionId, not a TDoc, clause, text occurrence or joined-row count. All fifteen cutoff identities are distinct. Independent whole421 typed SQL/Python comparison preserves eight duplicated Agreement IDs due to old MADE_AT aliases at meeting100. They cannot occupy the115 cutoff and are not silently deduplicated.
counting unit and join multiplicity.query_evidence: Original MADE_AT traversal and RETURN retained without DISTINCT. The source-eligibility bridge validates the limited ten full rows against their immutable SQL values and scores only requested identities.
counting unit and join multiplicity.assessment: PASS for selected-output identity multiplicity. The canonical full-pool group constructor rejects the below-cutoff duplicates; C preserves that diagnostic rather than modifying the fixed kernel. Its separate explicit eligible15/limited10 supplement is a prospective bridge requiring ROOT integration, not a claim that the unchanged production full-pool verifier already passes. Eligible15 must never be labelled native gold10.

cardinality and completeness.independent_derivation: The exact authored item supplies LIMIT10. Actual own-source and retained SQL establish nine required identities above meeting115 and six distinct eligible identities at115, so there are exactly six valid10-identity sets. All six source boundary alternatives retain active own keywords. Source frontier checks and monotone removal address possible displacement; they do not certify all historical Agreement text.
cardinality and completeness.query_evidence: ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT10 unchanged; top_k_boundary_ties value10 and9 mandatory plus1 of6 boundary candidates.
cardinality and completeness.assessment: PASS for the proposed cardinality and finite completeness contract. The actual immutable SQL result is ten rows; source eligibility has fifteen. No native output was executed or inspected by this agent. A ROOT exact-query native10 capture, full three-column SQL binding and limited-output supplement execution remain execution gates; semantic acceptance here cannot substitute for those gates.

ordering and ties when requested.independent_derivation: The original exact query uses only numeric meetingNumberInt DESC and a limit. Neither the English List nor its Korean item requests serialized rank, and no sequence, agenda, ID or calendar secondary key is authored. The generic temporal-trend category and CQ1 defaults must not invent an item-specific tie breaker. Therefore one of the six equally recent boundary identities is admissible without selecting a preferred ID.
ordering and ties when requested.query_evidence: Single original numeric DESC key; any_subset_at_boundary, within_tie_order any, require_rank_order false. Independent SQL diagnostic ID sorting is display-only.
ordering and ties when requested.assessment: PASS for selection by the preserved numeric-meeting key with arbitrary tie membership/serialization. This is not a claim that numeric meeting keys encode physical calendar chronology for every meeting. All nine above-cutoff identities remain mandatory in every permitted answer, so arbitrary serialization does not allow a lower record to displace a newer one.
